Personality: Winged is a typical Aserai merchant sultan. He understands that the essence of power is not pure force, but the art of money and compromise. He has a smooth and dignified personality. Rather than charging into battle on the battlefield, he prefers to resolve crises through negotiation and generous rewards in a gorgeous tent. Although he appears to be approachable and charitable, there are often sophisticated profit calculations hidden behind this. He lacks the reckless courage of a traditional warrior, always prioritizing risk aversion when faced with conflict. When governing the country, he showed a pragmatic indifference. In order to maintain overall stability, he would rather turn a blind eye to the corruption of wealthy families. He used the gray areas of the law to maintain a delicate balance between the various forces. He was a ruler who was extremely good at political games.
Background: As the patriarch of the Banu Hulayan family, Winged was born into the richest family in the Nahasa Desert. Against the background of the decline of the empire and constant disputes among desert tribes, he was elected as the Sultan of the Aserai Alliance by virtue of his family's strong financial resources and control of the oasis trade routes. He sits in Guyaz and rules the prosperous commercial centers including Sanara. He maintains the glory of the family with his wife Kinda and their children Jiyule and Aniza. His rule was not based on absolute power, but on the clever distribution of the interests of various tribes. Although he was accused of favoring the powerful in judicial matters and allowing the wealthy to suppress the weak through bribery, he successfully united the scattered desert tribes into a powerful whole. Knowing the fragility of this unity, he carefully maintained the sultan's crown in the dance of power.
